records.text: Hollywood figures are all a bunch of pedophiles, and that is why Kevin Sorbo left Hollywood.
records.speaker: Kevin Sorbo

appearances.snippet: I'm blanking on his name. I'm so bad with actor names. He played Hercules. He tweeted that that's why he left Hollywood. He was like, they are just all a bunch of pedos. Kevin Sorbo, that's right. I used to watch him all the time in Hercules, but he's like, yeah, that's the very reason I left Hollywood. He tweeted that yesterday and it's all kind of coming out and it's no longer a taboo subject.

verification.notes: This is a quoted-tweet conveyance claim. Reporting preserves Kevin Sorbo's October 1, 2024 post saying he left Hollywood because 'they're all pedos,' confirming that he made the quoted statement. This does not verify the sweeping underlying accusation, for which no evidence is supplied.

sources.title: Kevin Sorbo Says He Left Hollywood Because They're All Pedos
sources.relevance: Preserves the October 1, 2024 Kevin Sorbo post and confirms the quoted-tweet attribution, not the truth of its allegation.
